Vice President of the OCA, opened the OCA AI Technology and E-Sports Seminar in Kuwait City.
The seminar brings together experts to discuss how artificial intelligence can help improve athlete performance, training methods, and the overall sports experience. Dr. Thani shared his excitement for the new ideas and opportunities that technology brings to sports.
The AI & Esports seminar concluded with OCA’s Director of Development and NOC Relations, Mr. Wissam Trkmani, presenting certificates of participation to our speakers.
